title: tephroseris integrifolia subsp. capitata
intro: Tephroseris integrifolia subsp. capitata, commonly known as alpine fleabane, is a rare flowering plant species found in the mountainous regions of Europe. As a plant with potential health benefits, alpine fleabane has been traditionally used to treat various ailments, including inflammation and digestive issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of alpine fleabane include reducing inflammation, fighting infections, and promoting wound healing, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects and mechanisms of alpine fleabane, and its use should be approached with caution and under the guidance of a healthcare professional.
